nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package initializer for the display screens module, providing the `log_display` debug logging helper and the `make_writer` factory function that wraps the Writer class with pixel-doubling and coordinate patching for the ePaper canvas.

nodes.name: log_display
nodes.summary: Formats and prints a labeled debug message for the EPD display layer, joining variadic string parts with ' | ' separators.

nodes.name: make_writer
nodes.summary: Factory function that creates a Writer instance for a given canvas and font, applying monkey-patches to scale pixel coordinates by 2 and to intercept printstring calls for ePaper-compatible rendering.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer for the mDNS service discovery subpackage, making the directory importable as a Python package with no additional top-level exports.

nodes.name: Pico_ePaper_3_7.py
nodes.summary: Low-level hardware driver for the Waveshare 3.7" ePaper display on Raspberry Pi Pico W, implementing the EPD_3in7 class with SPI communication, GPIO control, 1-bit and 4-gray display modes, partial refresh, LUT loading, and power management.
nodes.languageNotes: MicroPython driver using machine.SPI and machine.Pin; manages two framebuffers (black and red channels) for 4-gray rendering by interleaving bit planes.

nodes.name: EPD_3in7
nodes.summary: Main ePaper display driver class encapsulating SPI initialization, hardware reset, command/data sending, LUT loading, 4-gray and 1-gray display modes, partial refresh, clear operations, and sleep/wake control for the 3.7-inch e-ink panel.

nodes.name: clock_big.py
nodes.summary: Bitmapped font data module for a large monospaced clock-style font, encoding glyph pixel data as packed binary bytes and exposing font metadata accessors (`height`, `max_width`, `hmap`, `reverse`, `monospaced`, `get_ch`) compatible with the MicroPython Writer interface.
nodes.languageNotes: Font glyph data is stored as a flat Python bytes literal; get_ch() uses index tables and binary search helpers to locate per-character slice offsets.

nodes.name: get_ch
nodes.summary: Looks up and returns the bitmap data, height, and width for a given character from the clock_big font's packed glyph table.

nodes.name: courier20.py
nodes.summary: Bitmapped font data module for the 20px Courier monospaced font, storing packed glyph bitmaps and providing font metadata and the `get_ch` character lookup function for use with the Writer rendering layer.

nodes.name: get_ch
nodes.summary: Returns the bitmap slice, height, and width for a given character by looking up its offset in the Courier20 glyph index table.

nodes.name: font10.py
nodes.summary: Bitmapped font data module for a 10px proportional font, encoding glyph bitmaps as packed bytes and exposing the standard Writer-compatible font interface including `get_ch` for character lookup.

nodes.name: get_ch
nodes.summary: Returns the bitmap data, height, and width for a given character from the font10 glyph table using offset-based indexing.

nodes.name: font6.py
nodes.summary: Bitmapped font data module for a compact 6px font, providing packed glyph binary data and the standard Writer-compatible metadata and `get_ch` character accessor.

nodes.name: get_ch
nodes.summary: Returns the bitmap data, height, and width for a character from the font6 glyph table.

nodes.name: freesans20.py
nodes.summary: Bitmapped font data module for the 20px FreeSans proportional sans-serif font, encoding glyph pixel data and providing the Writer-compatible font interface including `get_ch` for character-level bitmap retrieval.

nodes.name: get_ch
nodes.summary: Returns the bitmap slice, height, and width for a given character from the freesans20 font's packed glyph data using inline offset arithmetic.

nodes.name: noto12.py
nodes.summary: Bitmapped font data module for the 12px Noto proportional font, storing an extended glyph set with binary search support (`bs` helper) and the standard `get_ch` lookup, suitable for rendering multi-language characters on the ePaper display.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a binary-search helper function `bs` to locate characters in a sorted index table, enabling sparse Unicode coverage beyond contiguous ASCII.

nodes.name: get_ch
nodes.summary: Looks up a character in the noto12 font index via binary search and returns the corresponding bitmap data and glyph dimensions.

nodes.name: noto20.py
nodes.summary: Bitmapped font data module for the 20px Noto proportional font with a large character set, using a binary-search index for sparse Unicode glyph lookup and providing the full Writer-compatible font interface.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest font file in the project (843 lines); binary search over a packed index allows O(log n) character lookup without a dense table, saving RAM on MicroPython.

nodes.name: get_ch
nodes.summary: Returns the glyph bitmap, height, and width for a character from the noto20 font using binary search over the glyph index.

nodes.name: writer_fw_compatible.py
nodes.summary: Legacy MicroPython Writer and CWriter class implementation retained for firmware compatibility reference, providing text rendering to a framebuffer device with word-wrapping, clipping, color support, and a fast native-code path via uctypes in CWriter.
nodes.languageNotes: CWriter extends Writer with a fast rendering path using uctypes.bytearray_at and addressof for direct memory-mapped framebuffer access, requiring a specific MicroPython build with native emitters enabled.

nodes.name: Writer
nodes.summary: Text rendering engine for MicroPython framebuffer devices that draws proportional or monospaced fonts with word-wrap, line clipping, tab support, and configurable foreground/background colors.

nodes.name: CWriter
nodes.summary: Optimized color Writer subclass that uses uctypes memory views for fast glyph blitting, falling back to a slow pixel-by-pixel path when native memory access is unavailable.

nodes.name: writer_minimal.py
nodes.summary: Minimal legacy Writer class for MicroPython, providing bare-minimum font rendering to a framebuffer device with line wrapping and `blit`-based character drawing, kept for historical reference.

nodes.name: Writer
nodes.summary: Lightweight text renderer that writes bitmapped font characters to a MicroPython framebuffer, handling newlines, clipping, and glyph blitting with minimal overhead.
